about.description:
PyCuAmpcor estimates the pixel offsets between two images with the
amplitude cross-correlation (feature, speckle or offset tracking) method,
e.g., for SAR images with ISCE2/ISCE3, or optical images. It reads raw
binary images, HDF5 datasets (e.g., NISAR RSLCs) and GDAL rasters, and has
the command-line tools dense_offsets, geo_offsets and plot_offsets. The cpu
variant provides PyCPUAmpcor; the cuda variant provides both PyCPUAmpcor
and PyCuAmpcor (GPU).
about.summary: Amplitude cross-correlation (ampcor) for SAR images with CPU (OpenMP) and CUDA backends

  # __cuda virtual package (an NVIDIA driver) is available; cpu builds otherwise
  build_offset: ${{ 100 if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else 0 }}
  build_prefix: ${{ "cuda" ~ (cuda_compiler_version | version_to_buildstring) if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu" }}
  cuda_option: ${{ "-Ccmake.define.PYCUAMPCOR_CUDA=ON -Ccmake.define.CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=all-major" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "-Ccmake.define.PYCUAMPCOR_CUDA=OFF" }}

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/earthdef/cuAmpcor/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 432df76f19169cda224e72a034cb662922363bad0b3ec9029ee61fd1a95337ba

build:
  number: ${{ build + build_offset }}
  string: ${{ build_prefix }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build + build_offset }}
  skip: win
  script:
    env:
      # use ninja (make is not a build dependency)
      CMAKE_GENERATOR: Ninja
    content:
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation -Ccmake.define.PYCUAMPCOR_HDF5=ON -Ccmake.define.PYCUAMPCOR_GDAL=ON ${{ cuda_option }}

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pybind11
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
    - cmake >=3.23
    - ninja
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - scikit-build-core >=0.10
    - pybind11
    - fftw
    - hdf5
    - zlib
    - libgdal-core
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - libcufft-dev
  run:
    - python
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: __cuda

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pycuampcor
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - numpy
        - h5py
        # the GDAL python bindings and matplotlib: the tests of the GDAL images, geo_offsets and plot_offsets
        - gdal
        - matplotlib-base
    script:
      - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
        then: python -c "import pycuampcor; assert pycuampcor.has_cuda"
        else: python -c "import pycuampcor; assert not pycuampcor.has_cuda"
      - python -c "import pycuampcor; assert pycuampcor.has_hdf5 and pycuampcor.has_gdal"
      - python -m pycuampcor.dense_offsets --help
      - python -m pycuampcor.geo_offsets --help
      - python -m pycuampcor.plot_offsets --help
      - pytest -v tests/python

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/earthdef/cuAmpcor
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - NOTICE
  summary: Amplitude cross-correlation (ampcor) for SAR images with CPU (OpenMP) and CUDA backends
  description: |
    PyCuAmpcor estimates the pixel offsets between two images with the
    amplitude cross-correlation (feature, speckle or offset tracking) method,
    e.g., for SAR images with ISCE2/ISCE3, or optical images. It reads raw
    binary images, HDF5 datasets (e.g., NISAR RSLCs) and GDAL rasters, and has
    the command-line tools dense_offsets, geo_offsets and plot_offsets. The cpu
    variant provides PyCPUAmpcor; the cuda variant provides both PyCPUAmpcor
    and PyCuAmpcor (GPU).
  repository: https://github.com/earthdef/cuAmpcor
  documentation: https://github.com/earthdef/cuAmpcor/blob/main/README.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - lijun99
